from pathlib import Path
import ast, importlib.util
p=Path('/work/textmask.py')
source=p.read_text()
compile(source, str(p), 'exec')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask',p)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

expected = [
 (('Alpha alpha alpha-beta ALPHA-BETA','alpha-beta'), 'x x x x'),
 (('ab cd ab-cd xab-cd ab-cdx','ab-cd'), 'ab cd x xab-cd ab-cdx'),
 (('Alpha alpha ALPHA-BETA','Alpha-Beta'), 'alpha alpha alpha-beta'),
 (('foobar foo-bar foo bar','foo-bar'), 'foobar x x x'),
 (('an ana-banana banana ana','ana-banana'), 'an x x x'),
]
for args, want in expected:
    got=m.masked(*args)
    assert got == want, (args, got, want)

tokens=m.name_tokens('long-name-long')
assert set(tokens)=={'long-name-long','long','name'}
assert [len(x) for x in tokens] == sorted(map(len,tokens), reverse=True)
assert len(tokens)==len(set(tokens))

# Verify the requested module shape and delegation.
tree=ast.parse(source)
body=[n for n in tree.body if not (isinstance(n, ast.Expr) and isinstance(n.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(n.value.value,str))]
assert len(body)==3
assert isinstance(body[0],ast.Import) and [a.name for a in body[0].names]==['re']
assert [n.name for n in body[1:] if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)]==['name_tokens','masked']
masked_fn=body[2]
assert any(isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='name_tokens' for n in ast.walk(masked_fn))
print(f'PASS: {len(expected)} baseline behavior cases')
print('PASS: unique descending-length name_tokens')
print('PASS: module shape and masked delegation')
